description: Live fixed price (EUR, per vehicle, VAT incl.) for a private transfer/chauffeur ride with Airport Transfer Connect — e.g. CDG airport to a Paris hotel. Returns prices for E-Class, V-Class, S-Class, availability and a prefilled booking_url.

date.description: Pickup date, YYYY-MM-DD (local time at pickup).

from.description: Pickup: airport IATA code (CDG, ORY, BVA, LBG, OTP, NCE, LHR…), hotel name + city, or full address.

luggage.description: Number of suitcases, defaults to passengers (alias accepted: bags).

return_date.description: Optional return date YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip.

time.description: Pickup time HH:MM 24h local. For airport pickups use the flight landing time.

to.description: Drop-off: airport IATA code, hotel name + city, or full address.

name: get_quote
title: Get transfer price
